decision.currentReleaseRenderer: SpriteKit on iOS/macOS and SwiftUI key poses or atlases on watchOS
rationale: The exported model, all nine logical parameter IDs and Cubism Core loading pass deterministic checks.
The Core motion probe returns exit 2 because none of the 12 tested parameter extremes changes drawable vertex hashes.
Cubism 5.4 Alpha External Application Integration does not expose ArtMesh vertex-coordinate editing, so MCP or GUI automation does not remove the real rigging bottleneck.
A custom canvas automation layer is not economical for one character and must not block the app.

milestone.nextAction: Keep the simulator acceptance green, then complete physical iPhone, Apple Watch and Mac acceptance; add Watch atlases only if they materially improve the fallback.

live2dResumeGate.onPass: Live2D runtime work may resume at the Native Metal host without building custom Cubism GUI automation.
live2dResumeGate.onFailure: Freeze Live2D for the current release and continue SpriteKit and watchOS atlas work.
prohibitedUntilPass: Installing or enabling a Cubism MCP
Building a custom Cubism keyform or canvas automation tool
Expanding the production Live2D PSD, physics or motion scope
